verses.geez: ይከብር፡ ነዳይ፡ በጥበቢሁ፡ ወይነብር፡ ማእከለ፡ መኳንንት።
verses.translation: Wisdom lifteth up the head of him that is of low degree, and maketh him to sit among great men.

translations.lxx: Wisdom lifteth up the head of him that is of low degree, and maketh him to sit among great men.
translations.ron: Înţelepciunea înalţă capul celui smerit şi-l face să şadă între cei mari.
translations.grk: Σοφία ταπεινοῦ ἀνύψωσε κεφαλὴν, καὶ ἐν μέσῳ μεγιστάνων καθίσει αὐτόν.

verses.geez: ኢታድሉ፡ ለሰብእ፡ እንበይነ፡ ላሕዩ፡ ወኢታስተአክዮ፡ ለሰብእ፡ እንበይነ፡ ሕሠሚሁ።
verses.translation: Commend not a man for his beauty; neither abhor a man for his outward appearance.

translations.lxx: Commend not a man for his beauty; neither abhor a man for his outward appearance.
translations.ron: Să nu lauzi pe om pentru frumuseţea lui şi să nu te scârbeşti de om pentru chipul lui.
translations.grk: Μὴ αἰνέσεις ἄνδρα ἐν κάλλει αὐτοῦ, καὶ μὴ βδελύξῃ ἄνθρωπον ἐν ὁράσει αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: እምኵሉ፡ አዕዋፍ፡ ትንዕስ፡ ንህብ፡ ወእምኵሉ፡ ይጥዕም፡ ፍሬሃ።
verses.translation: The bee is little among such as fly; but her fruit is the chief of sweet things.

translations.lxx: The bee is little among such as fly; but her fruit is the chief of sweet things.
translations.ron: Mică este între cele zburătoare albina, dar rodul ei întrece orice dulceaţă.
translations.grk: Μικρὰ ἐν πετεινοῖς μέλισσα, καὶ ἀρχὴ γλυκασμάτων ὁ καρπὸς αὐτῆς.

verses.geez: ኢትዘኀር፡ በሥነ፡ አልባሲከ፡ በመዋዕለ፡ ክብርከኒ፡ ኢታዕቢ፡ ርእሰከ፡ እስመ፡ ነኪር፡ ግብሩ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ወኅቡእ፡ እምዕጓለ፡ እመሕያው፡ ኪኑ።
verses.translation: Boast not of thy clothing and raiment, and exalt not thyself in the day of honour: for the works of the Lord are wonderful, and his works among men are hidden.

translations.lxx: Boast not of thy clothing and raiment, and exalt not thyself in the day of honour: for the works of the Lord are wonderful, and his works among men are hidden.
translations.ron: Cu îmbrăcămintea hainelor să nu te lauzi, nici în ziua măririi să nu te trufeşti, că minunate sunt lucrurile Domnului şi ascunse faptele Lui între oameni.
translations.grk: Ἐν περιβολῇ ἱματίων μὴ καυχήσῃ, καὶ ἐν ἡμέρᾳ δόξης μὴ ἐπαίρου, ὅτι θαυμαστὰ τὰ ἔργα Κυρίου, καὶ κρυπτὰ τὰ ἔργα αὐτοῦ ἐν ἀνθρώποις.

verses.geez: ብዙኃን፡ መኳንንት፡ እለ፡ ወድቁ፡ ውስተ፡ ምድር፡ ወቦ፡ ባሕታዊ፡ ዘተቀጸለ፡ አክሊለ።
verses.translation: Many kings have sat down upon the ground; and one that was never thought of hath worn the crown.

translations.lxx: Many kings have sat down upon the ground; and one that was never thought of hath worn the crown.
translations.ron: Mulţi tirani au căzut pe pământ, iar cel la care nu se gândea nimeni a purtat stema.
translations.grk: Πολλοὶ τύραννοι ἐκάθισαν ἐπὶ ἐδάφους, ὁ δὲ ἀνυπονόητος ἐφόρεσε διάδημα.

verses.geez: ብዙኃን፡ ዐበይት፡ እለ፡ ኀሥሩ፡ ፈድፋደ፡ ወብዙኃን፡ ክቡራን፡ እለ፡ ገብኡ፡ ታሕተ፡ ባዕድ።
verses.translation: Many mighty men have been greatly disgraced; and the honourable delivered into other men's hands.

translations.lxx: Many mighty men have been greatly disgraced; and the honourable delivered into other men's hands.
translations.ron: Mulţi puternici au fost necinstiţi foarte şi cei măreţi au fost daţi în mâinile altora.
translations.grk: Πολλοὶ δυνάσται ἠτιμάσθησαν σφόδρα, καὶ ἔνδοξοι παρεδόθησαν εἰς χεῖρας ἑτέρων.

verses.geez: ኢትኂስ፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ትሕትቶ፡ ጠይቅ፡ ቅድመ፡ ወድኅረ፡ ትጌሥጽ።
verses.translation: Blame not before thou hast examined the truth: understand first, and then rebuke.

translations.lxx: Blame not before thou hast examined the truth: understand first, and then rebuke.
translations.ron: Mai înainte de a cerceta, nu huli; cunoaşte întâi şi atunci dojeneşte.
translations.grk: Πρὶν ἐξετάσῃς μὴ μέμψῃ· νόησον πρῶτον καὶ τότε ἐπιτιμα.

verses.geez: ዘእንበለ፡ ትስማዕ፡ ኢታውሥእ፡ ወውስተ፡ ነገረ፡ ባዕድ፡ ኢትባእ።
verses.translation: Answer not before thou hast heard the cause: neither interrupt men in the midst of their talk.

translations.lxx: Answer not before thou hast heard the cause: neither interrupt men in the midst of their talk.
translations.ron: Mai înainte de a nu auzi, nu răspunde; şi nu tăia nimănui şirul cuvintelor.
translations.grk: Πρὶν ἢ ἀκοῦσαι μὴ ἀποκρίνου, καὶ ἐν μέσῳ λόγων μὴ παρεμβάλλου.

verses.geez: ወውስተ፡ ዘኢኮነ፡ ትካዝከ፡ ኢትትኀለፍ፡ ወኢትሳነን፡ በቀስተ፡ ጊጉይ።
verses.translation: Strive not in a matter that concerneth thee not; and sit not in judgment with sinners.

translations.lxx: Strive not in a matter that concerneth thee not; and sit not in judgment with sinners.
translations.ron: Pentru lucrul care nu-ţi este de folos, nu te certa şi la judecata păcătoşilor să nu stai împreună cu ei.
translations.grk: Περὶ πράγματος οὗ οὐκ ἔστι σοι χρεία, μὴ ἔριζε, καὶ ἐν κρίσει ἁμαρτωλῶν μὴ συνέδρευε.

verses.geez: ወልድየ፡ ኢታብዝኅ፡ ተግባረከ፡ እስመ፡ ለእመ፡ አብዛኅከ፡ ትጸደቅ፡ ኢያበውሐከ፡ ወኢታመሥጥ፡ ለእመ፡ ሮጽከ፡ ወኢትረክባ፡ ለእመ፡ ዴገንከ፡ ለጽድቅ።
verses.translation: My son, meddle not with many matters: for if thou meddle much, thou shalt not be innocent; and if thou follow after, thou shalt not obtain, neither shalt thou escape by fleeing.

translations.lxx: My son, meddle not with many matters: for if thou meddle much, thou shalt not be innocent; and if thou follow after, thou shalt not obtain, neither shalt thou escape by fleeing.
translations.ron: Fiule! Nu te amesteca în multe lucruri,
translations.grk: Τέκνον, μὴ περὶ πολλὰ ἔστωσαν αἱ πράξεις σου· ἐὰν πληθυνῇς, οὐκ ἀθωωθήσῃ· καὶ ἐὰν διώκῃς, οὐ μὴ καταλάβῃς, καὶ οὐ μὴ ἐκφύγῃς διαδράς.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ቦ፡ ዘይጔጕእ፡ ወይሠርሕ፡ ወይጻሙ፡ ወፈድፋደ፡ ይጼነስ።
verses.translation: There is one that laboureth, and taketh pains, and maketh haste, and is so much the more behind.

translations.lxx: There is one that laboureth, and taketh pains, and maketh haste, and is so much the more behind.
translations.ron: Că de te vei amesteca în multe lucruri, nu vei fi fără de vină.
translations.grk: Ἔστι κοπιῶν καὶ πονῶν καὶ σπεύδων, καὶ τόσῳ μᾶλλον ὑστερεῖται.

verses.geez: ወቦ፡ እንዘ፡ ድኩም፡ ውእቱ፡ ኢይስእል፡ ወዘይመልክ፡ ወኢይክል፡ ምንተኒ፡ ወለእመኒ፡ ጸንዐ፡ ፈድፋደ፡ ይጼነስ፡ ወለአመ፡ ነጸሮ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ በሠናይ፡ ያነሥኦ፡ እምተጽናሱ።
verses.translation: Again, there is another that is slow, and hath need of help, wanting ability, and full of poverty; yet the eye of the Lord looked upon him for good, and set him up from his low estate,

translations.lxx: Again, there is another that is slow, and hath need of help, wanting ability, and full of poverty; yet the eye of the Lord looked upon him for good, and set him up from his low estate,
translations.ron: Şi de vei alerga, nu vei prinde, şi de vei fugi, nu vei scăpa.
translations.grk: Ἔστι νωθρὸς καὶ προσδεόμενος ἀντιλήψεως, ὑστερῶν ἰσχύϊ, καὶ πτωχείᾳ περισσεύει, καὶ οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ Κυρίου ἐπέβλεψαν αὐτῷ εἰς ἀγαθὰ, καὶ ἀνώρθωσεν αὐτὸν ἐκ ταπεινώσεως αὐτοῦ·

verses.geez: ወያዐብዮ፡ ወያከብሮ፡ ወያነክርዎ፡ ብዙኃን።
verses.translation: and lifted up his head from misery; so that many that saw it marvelled at him.

translations.lxx: and lifted up his head from misery; so that many that saw it marvelled at him.
translations.ron: Este câte un om care se osteneşte şi munceşte şi se sârguieşte şi cu atât mai mult este sărac.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀνύψωσε κεφαλὴν αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἀπεθαύμασαν ἐπʼ αὐτῷ πολλοί.

verses.geez: ሠናይትኒ፡ ወእኪትኒ።
verses.translation: Prosperity and adversity, life and death, poverty and riches, come of the Lord.

translations.lxx: Prosperity and adversity, life and death, poverty and riches, come of the Lord.
translations.ron: Este câte un om slab şi fără de ajutor, lipsit de putere şi împovărat de sărăcie,
translations.grk: Ἀγαθὰ καὶ κακά, ζωὴ καὶ θάνατος, πτωχεία καὶ πλοῦτος παρὰ Κυρίου ἐστί.

verses.geez: ሐይውኒ፡ ወመዊትኒ።

translations.ron: Şi ochii Domnului au căutat spre el cu bine şi l-au ridicat din smerenia lui şi au înălţat capul lui, şi s-au mirat de el mulţi.

verses.geez: ነዳይኒ፡ ወብዕልኒ፡ እምኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር።

translations.ron: Cele bune şi cele rele, viaţa şi moartea, sărăcia şi avuţia de la Domnul sunt.

verses.geez: ጸጋሁ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ትዜውሮሙ፡ ለጻድቃን፡ ወፈቃዱሂ፡ ያስተፌሥሕ፡ ዓለመ።
verses.translation: The gift of the Lord remaineth with the godly, and his favour bringeth prosperity for ever.

translations.lxx: The gift of the Lord remaineth with the godly, and his favour bringeth prosperity for ever.
translations.ron: Darul Domnului rămâne la cei binecredincioşi şi bunăvoinţa Lui în veac bine va spori.
translations.grk: Δόσις Κυρίου παραμένει εὐσεβέσι, καὶ ἡ εὐδοκία αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα εὐοδωθήσεται.

verses.geez: ሀሎ፡ ዘይብዕል፡ በብዝኀ፡ ጠዊዕ፡ ወእንዘ፡ ይቄቂ፡ ወባቲ፡ ይሤልጥ፡ ትፍሥሕቶ።
verses.translation: There is that waxeth rich by his wariness and pinching, and this is the portion of his reward:

translations.lxx: There is that waxeth rich by his wariness and pinching, and this is the portion of his reward:
translations.ron: Este câte un om care se îmbogăţeşte prin multă grijă şi zgârcenie şi aceasta este partea ostenelilor lui,
translations.grk: Ἔστι πλουτῶν ἀπὸ προσοχῆς καὶ σφιγγίας αὐτοῦ, καὶ αὕτη ἡ μερὶς τοῦ μισθοῦ αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ወአመ፡ ተሰፈወ፡ ያዕርፍ፡ ወአመ፡ ይብል፡ እበልዕ፡ ወእሰቲ፡ እንከሰ፡ እፌግዕ፡ ወአእከልኩ፡ ወኢየአምር፡ ዕለት፡ እንተ፡ ትበጽሖ፡ ወየኅድግ፡ ኵሎ፡ ለባዕድ፡ ወይመውት፡ ውእቱ።
verses.translation: whereas he saith, I have found rest, and now will eat continually of my goods; and yet he knoweth not what time shall come upon him, and that he must leave those things to others, and die.

translations.lxx: whereas he saith, I have found rest, and now will eat continually of my goods; and yet he knoweth not what time shall come upon him, and that he must leave those things to others, and die.
translations.ron: Zicând: Am aflat odihnă şi acum voi mânca din bunătăţile mele,
translations.grk: Ἐν τῷ εἰπεῖν αὐτὸν, εὗρον ἀνάπαυσιν, καὶ νῦν φάγωμαι ἐκ τῶν ἀγαθῶν μου, καὶ οὐκ οἶδε τίς καιρὸς παρελεύσεται, καὶ καταλείψει αὐτὰ ἑτέροις, καὶ ἀποθανεῖται.

verses.geez: ቁም፡ በፍርሀተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ወቦቱ፡ ተመሀር፡ ወርሳዕ፡ በተግባርከ።
verses.translation: Be stedfast in thy covenant, and be conversant therein, and wax old in thy work.

translations.lxx: Be stedfast in thy covenant, and be conversant therein, and wax old in thy work.
translations.ron: Şi nu ştie că vremea trece şi va muri şi le va lăsa altora.
translations.grk: Στῆθι ἐν διαθήκῃ σου καὶ ὁμίλει ἐν αὐτῇ, καὶ ἐν τῷ ἔργῳ σου παλαιώθητι.

verses.geez: ወኢያፍቱከ፡ ግብሮሙ፡ ለኃጥኣን፡ ተአመን፡ በእግዚአብሔር፡ ወተሰፈዎ፡ ለጻማከ፡ እስመ፡ ቀሊል፡ በኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ኵሉ፡ ለምዕር፡ ወግብተ፡ ያብዕሎ፡ ለነዳይ።
verses.translation: Marvel not at the works of sinners; but trust in the Lord, and abide in thy labour: for it is an easy thing in the sight of the Lord on the sudden to make a poor man rich.

translations.lxx: Marvel not at the works of sinners; but trust in the Lord, and abide in thy labour: for it is an easy thing in the sight of the Lord on the sudden to make a poor man rich.
translations.ron: Stai în ce te-ai făgăduit tu şi întru aceea îndeletniceşte-te şi petrece, şi intru lucrul tău sporeşte.
translations.grk: Μὴ θαύμαζε ἐν ἔργοις ἁμαρτωλοῦ, πίστευε τῷ Κυρίῳ καὶ ἔμμενε τῷ πόνῳ σου· ὅτι κοῦφον ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς Κυρίου διὰ τάχους ἐξάπινα πλουτίσαι πένητα.

verses.geez: በረከተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ዕሴቶሙ፡ ለጻድቃን፡ ወትትባዛኅ፡ በረከቱ፡ ለጻድቅ።
verses.translation: The blessing of the Lord is in the reward of the godly, and suddenly he maketh his blessing to flourish.

translations.lxx: The blessing of the Lord is in the reward of the godly, and suddenly he maketh his blessing to flourish.
translations.ron: Nu te mira de lucrările păcătosului; nădăjduieşte în Domnul şi rămâi întru osteneala ta.
translations.grk: Εὐλογία Κυρίου ἐν μισθῷ εὐσεβοῦς, καὶ ἐν ὥρᾳ ταχινῇ ἀναθάλλει εὐλογίαν αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ወኢትበል፡ ኢይፈቅድ፡ እንከ፡ ወኢትበል፡ አልብየ፡ ዕሴት፡ እንከ።
verses.translation: Say not, What profit is there of my service? and what good things shall I have hereafter?

translations.lxx: Say not, What profit is there of my service? and what good things shall I have hereafter?
translations.ron: Că lesne este înaintea Domnului a îmbogăţi pe cel sărac degrabă şi fără de veste.
translations.grk: Μὴ εἴπῃς, τίς ἐστί μου χρεία; καὶ τίνα ἀπὸ τοῦ νῦν ἔσται μου τὰ ἀγαθά;

verses.geez: እምይእዜሰ፡ አከለኒ፡ ወእምይእዜሰ፡ ኢይጼነስ፡ እንከ።
verses.translation: Again, say not, I have enough, and possess many things, and what evil can come to me hereafter?

translations.lxx: Again, say not, I have enough, and possess many things, and what evil can come to me hereafter?
translations.ron: Binecuvântarea Domnului este plata celui credincios şi într-un ceas, degrabă, răsare binecuvântarea Lui.
translations.grk: Μὴ εἴπῃς, αὐτάρκη μοι ἐστὶ, καὶ τί ἀπὸ τοῦ νῦν κακωθήσομαι;

verses.geez: አመ፡ ዕለተ፡ ሠናይት፡ ይረስዕዋ፡ ለእኪት፡ ወአመ፡ ዕለተ፡ እኪት፡ ይረስዕዋ፡ ለሠናይት።
verses.translation: In the day of prosperity there is a forgetfulness of affliction: and in the day of affliction there is no more remembrance of prosperity.

translations.lxx: In the day of prosperity there is a forgetfulness of affliction: and in the day of affliction there is no more remembrance of prosperity.
translations.ron: Să nu zici: De ce am nevoie? Şi de acum, care va fi averea mea?
translations.grk: Ἐν ἡμέρᾳ ἀγαθῶν ἀμνησία κακῶν, καὶ ἐν ἡμέρᾳ κακῶν οὐ μνησθήσεται ἀγαθῶν·

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ቀሊል፡ በኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ዕለተ፡ ሞት፡ እስመ፡ ይፈድዮ፡ ለሰብእ፡ በከመ፡ ግዕዙ።
verses.translation: For it is an easy thing unto the Lord in the day of death to reward a man according to his ways.

translations.lxx: For it is an easy thing unto the Lord in the day of death to reward a man according to his ways.
translations.ron: Să nu zici: Am destule, pentru ce să mă mai necăjesc de acum:
translations.grk: ὅτι κοῦφον ἔναντι Κυρίου ἐν ἡμέρᾳ τελευτῆς ἀποδοῦναι ἀνθρώπῳ κατὰ τὰς ὁδοὺς αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: በእኪት፡ ዕለት፡ ይከሪ፡ ጽጋብ፡ ወበደኃሪቱ፡ ለሰብእ፡ ይትዐወቅ፡ ምግባሩ።
verses.translation: The affliction of an hour maketh a man forget pleasure: and in his end his deeds shall be discovered.

translations.lxx: The affliction of an hour maketh a man forget pleasure: and in his end his deeds shall be discovered.
translations.ron: În ziua bunătăţilor este uitarea răutăţilor şi în ziua răutăţilor nu este pomenirea bunătăţilor.
translations.grk: Κάκωσις ὥρας ἐπιλησμονὴν ποιεῖ τρυφῆς, καὶ ἐν συντελείᾳ ἀνθρώπου ἀποκάλυψις ἔργων αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ወኢትበሎ፡ ለሰብእ፡ ብፁዕ፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ትርአይ፡ ደኃሪቶ፡ ወበላዕለ፡ ውሉዱ፡ ያስተርኢ፡ ንብረቱ፡ ለሰብእ።
verses.translation: Judge none blessed before his death: for a man shall be known in his children.

translations.lxx: Judge none blessed before his death: for a man shall be known in his children.
translations.ron: Că lesne este înaintea Domnului, în ziua sfârşitului, să dea omului după căile lui.
translations.grk: Πρὸ τελευτῆς μὴ μακάριζε μηδένα, καὶ ἐν τέκνοις αὐτῶυ γνωσθήσεται ἀνήρ.

verses.geez: ኢታብእ፡ ኵሎ፡ ሰብእ፡ ዘረከብከ፡ ውስተ፡ ቤትከ፡ እስመ፡ በብዙኀ፡ ይጠበበከ፡ ጕሕልያ።
verses.translation: Bring not every man into thine house: for the deceitful man hath many trains.

translations.lxx: Bring not every man into thine house: for the deceitful man hath many trains.
translations.ron: Vremea de restrişte aduce uitarea desfătărilor şi la sfârşitul omului se vor descoperi lucrurile lui.
translations.grk: Μὴ πάντα ἄνθρωπον εἴσαγε εἰς τὸν οἶκόν σου, πολλὰ γὰρ τὰ ἔνεδρα τοῦ δολίου.

verses.geez: ቆቃሕ፡ ተሠግረ፡ በቈጽለ፡ አስርቆ፡ ከማሁ፡ ልቡ፡ ለእቡይ፡ ወከመ፡ ሰብአ፡ ዐይን፡ ይትሔዘባ፡ ለድቀቱ።
verses.translation: Like as a partridge taken [and kept] in a cage, so is the heart of the proud: and like as a spy, watcheth he for thy fall:

translations.lxx: Like as a partridge taken [and kept] in a cage, so is the heart of the proud: and like as a spy, watcheth he for thy fall:
translations.ron: Mai înainte de sfârşit pe nimeni să nu-l socoteşti fericit, că în fiii săi se va cunoaşte omul.
translations.grk: Πέρδιξ θηρευτὴς ἐν καρτάλλῳ, οὕτως καρδία ὑπερηφάνου, καὶ ὡς ὁ κατάσκοπος ἐπιβλέπει πτῶσιν.

verses.geez: መጠነ፡ ሠናይት፡ እኪተ፡ የዐስየከ፡ ጕሕልያ፡ ወይገብር፡ ለከ፡ ነውረ፡ በዘአልብከ።
verses.translation: for he lieth in wait, and turneth good into evil, and in things worthy praise will lay blame upon thee.

translations.lxx: for he lieth in wait, and turneth good into evil, and in things worthy praise will lay blame upon thee.
translations.ron: Nu băga pe tot omul în casa ta, că multe sunt meşteşugirile celui viclean.
translations.grk: Τὰ γὰρ ἀγαθὰ εἰς κακὰ μεταστρέφων ἐνεδρεύει, καὶ ἐν τοῖς αἱρετοῖς ἐπιθήσει μῶμον.

verses.geez: በብዝኀ፡ ትንታጉ፡ ለእሳት፡ ይበዝኅ፡ ፍሕሙ፡ ወብእሲሰ፡ ኃጥእ፡ ይንዕዋ፡ ለነፍሱ።
verses.translation: Of a spark of fire a heap of coals is kindled: and a sinful man layeth wait for blood.

translations.lxx: Of a spark of fire a heap of coals is kindled: and a sinful man layeth wait for blood.
translations.ron: Potârniche închisă în coşniţă, aşa este inima trufaşului, şi ca iscoada priveşte căderea.
translations.grk: Ἀπὸ σπινθῆρος πυρὸς πληθύνεται ἀνθρακία, καὶ ἄνθρωπος ἁμαρτωλὸς εἰς αἷμα ἐνεδρεύει.

verses.geez: ተዐቀብ፡ እምነ፡ እኩይ፡ እስመ፡ እኪተ፡ ይፈጥር፡ ከመ፡ ኢይግበር፡ ለዝሉፉ፡ ጽዕለተ፡ ላዕሌከ።
verses.translation: Take heed of a mischievous man, for he worketh wickedness: lest he bring upon thee a perpetual blot.

translations.lxx: Take heed of a mischievous man, for he worketh wickedness: lest he bring upon thee a perpetual blot.
translations.ron: Că cele bune le întoarce cu viclenie în rele şi pentru cele bune te va huli.
translations.grk: Πρόσεχε ἀπὸ κακούργου, πονηρὰ γὰρ τεκταίνει, μήποτε μῶμον εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα δῷ σοι.

verses.geez: ለእመ፡ አኅደርከ፡ ነኪረ፡ ምስሌከ፡ የሀውከከ፡ ወየዐልወከ፡ ወያወፅአከ፡ እምንዋይከ።
verses.translation: Receive a stranger into thine house, and he will disturb thee, and turn thee out of thine own.

translations.lxx: Receive a stranger into thine house, and he will disturb thee, and turn thee out of thine own.
translations.ron: Dintr-o scânteie de foc se înmulţeşte jarul, şi omul păcătos pândeşte sângele.
translations.grk: Ἐνοίκισον ἀλλότριον, καὶ διαστρέψει σε ἐν ταραχαῖς, καὶ ἀπαλλοτριώσει σε τῶν ἰδίων σου.
